kizunaNote: kizunasync.push response (JSON:API / AIP-233 shape). A non-atomic batch and a successful atomic batch carry per-mutation verdicts under the correlation D-verdict-correlation ratified; an atomic rejection returns the D-atomic-batch-abort batch outcome; a stale schema_version returns the D-schema-version-handshake RESET_REQUIRED signal before any mutation runs.

oneOf.kizunaNote: Success arm: one verdict per request mutation, in request order and carrying mutation_id. D-verdict-correlation ratified this dual correlation and invariant I-5 enforces the bijection. Replays return recorded verdicts (P:verdict-completeness-transforms-and-conflict-rejection).
Atomic-abort arm (D-atomic-batch-abort decided): the batch reverted entirely; a single batch outcome names the offender, no member verdicts. The bijection (I-5) is conditional on success.

offender_mutation_id.kizunaNote: The mutation whose rejection reverted the batch.

reason.kizunaNote: The offender's rejection reason: the same closed union the per-mutation verdict carries (D-rejection-reasons). SUPERSEDED is the hlc-mode literal (conflict/003).

server_row.kizunaNote: The offender's compensating-revert row (P:verdict-completeness-transforms-and-conflict-rejection); null when invoker-invisible (RLS) or deleted (delete-wins), D-rejection-reasons note.

oneOf.kizunaNote: Stale-schema arm (D-schema-version-handshake decided): a push whose schema_version is below the configured minimum is gated BEFORE any mutation and returns a typed RESET_REQUIRED signal, symmetric with the pull-side handshake (lifecycle/002, lifecycle/003), never a fabricated verdict. The client soft-blocks and prompts update (P:schema-version-signalling); the outbox and the exactly-once watermark are untouched.

signal.kizunaNote: RESET_REQUIRED only: the push-side schema handshake mirrors the pull signal (CHECKPOINT_EXPIRED is a cursor concept, pull-only).
